newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Nine stocks fell, four rose and seven were flat in seven-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Wednesday with the WIG 20 index down 0.1 percent to 1,496.7 points.
The remaining nine stocks did not trade.
Three National Investment Funds (NFIs) fell and 10 were flat. Two did not trade.
NFI units fell 1.6 percent to 123 zlotys in 3.9-million-zloty turnover.
